attributes.name: Priyesh Mishra
attributes.title: UI/UX Designer & SMM Strategist
attributes.short_bio: I am a passionate UI/UX Designer with over 2 years of experience creating impactful digital experiences across SaaS, Fintech, eCommerce, and Spiritual brands. My design philosophy blends creativity with data-driven decisions, ensuring every product I build is both visually appealing and performance focused. I also help brands grow their digital presence through strategic content and storytelling.

api::service.service.title: UI/UX Design
api::service.service.description: Creating intuitive and engaging user experiences for websites, mobile apps, and dashboards that drive user satisfaction and business growth.

api::service.service.title: Product Design
api::service.service.description: Developing comprehensive design solutions including wireframes, prototypes, and scalable design systems that enhance user experience.

api::service.service.title: Social Media Strategy
api::service.service.description: Strategic content planning and community engagement growth, helping brands build meaningful connections with their audience.

api::service.service.title: Branding & Visual Identity
api::service.service.description: Creating cohesive brand identities through logo design, style guides, and brand kits that resonate with target audiences.

api::service.service.title: UI/UX Design
api::service.service.description: Designing user-centric interfaces that are intuitive, engaging, and deliver a seamless user experience.

api::service.service.title: Web Design
api::service.service.description: Building responsive and visually stunning websites that are optimized for performance and conversion.

api::service.service.title: App Design
api::service.service.description: Crafting beautiful and functional mobile app designs for both iOS and Android platforms.

api::project.project.title: Youtube Studio
api::project.project.description: Redesigned the UI/UX of the YouTube Studio App to enhance creator experience, improve analytics visualization, and deliver a modern, responsive, and engaging interface. Focused on dashboard redesign, user-friendly navigation, and interactive data insights.

api::project.project.title: TruCard-Fintech Platform UX Redesign
api::project.project.description: Created a clean and engaging UI/UX for TruCard, a Delhi-based fintech offering bullion-secured cards and digital bullion transfers. Focused on enhancing financial accessibility, trust, and user engagement through intuitive layouts highlighting gold/silver savings, e-vouchers, and secure transactions.

api::project.project.title: Equiwings.com
api::project.project.description: Created a storyline-driven UI/UX for Equiwings, India's leading equestrian ecosystem. Focused on brand vision, accessibility, and engagement, highlighting products, sponsors, events, and legacy while delivering a modern and professional user experience.

api::project.project.title: Spiritualtalksofficial Social Brand
api::project.project.description: Scaled Instagram to 160,000+ followers using content strategy and storytelling.

api::experience.experience.description: Designed and optimized SaaS product experiences using user research and testing. Built scalable design systems aligned with accessibility standards.
Delivered UI/UX and branding solutions for clients across multiple industries. Helped spiritual and lifestyle brands grow their online communities.
Strategized content design and community growth to build an audience of over 160,000+ followers. Designed creative assets and engagement funnels for spiritual branding.
Developed and maintained client websites using modern frontend technologies, focusing on responsive design and performance.

api::education.education.description: Focused on human-computer interaction, software engineering, and web development principles.

api::testimonial.testimonial.quote: Working with Alex was a game-changer. The new design has significantly boosted our user engagement. Truly exceptional work!
The attention to detail and creative vision brought our brand to life. I couldn't be happier with the results.
